parameters.name: CriteriaType
parameters.description:
The query type of the element to query. Valid values:

- **EDGE**: connection information.

parameters.name: CurrentPage
parameters.description: The page number of the page to return. Default value: **1**, which indicates that the first page is returned.

parameters.name: DstNode
parameters.description: The destination node information, which is used to filter destination nodes.

parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description: The end time of the network connectivity.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description:
The maximum number of entries per page in a paged query. Default value: 20. If the PageSize parameter is left empty, 20 entries are returned by default.
> Do not leave PageSize empty.

parameters.name: SrcNode
parameters.description: The source node information, which is used to filter source nodes.

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description: The start time of the network connectivity.
